features: THE BALANCE SHEET PAGE — Until now the balance sheet was a box with two totals above the General Ledger and a modal declared provisional. It is now a page in the Movements bar: the financial position item by item, the cash summary of the financial year, the reconciliation checks, and the print. It is the page used to verify that the whole set of accounts adds up, and every figure it shows is verified by tests with hand-calculated expected values.

A SNAPSHOT, NOT THE YEAR'S FLOW — Every balance is what the accounts held on a date — today for the open year, the end date for a closed one — including everything that happened before, even in previous years. The engine used to add up only the year's entries: from the second year on, inherited cash, receivables and payables disappeared. The year's flows (cash summary and operating result) stay per financial year, like the General Ledger; if an entry is dated outside its year, a check measures it. The box on the General Ledger is unchanged.

ASSETS + COSTS = LIABILITIES, WITH THE REAL FIGURES — Instalments issued to unit owners are recorded as a liability of the management, not as revenue. Costs not yet settled are expenses paid on behalf of the owners and sit in the assets column, listed one by one: so the two columns end on the same figure, with the verdict «reconciliation: balanced» below. It is the same equality as debit = credit in the General Ledger, and the General Ledger box now writes it in the same form — it used to say «more expenses than charged» even when instalments exceeded expenses. The operating result has its name: instalments issued minus costs, the surplus or deficit that will go to the final adjustment.

SIX CHECKS WITH A NAME, AND EACH ONE SAYS HOW TO FIX IT — No codes and no traffic light: double entry (debit = credit, the same total as the General Ledger), balance sheet reconciliation, cash-to-accrual bridge, restrictions and fund accounts, cash and summary, real accounts below zero. Each card shows the equation with the amounts, the outcome and a note; when it fails it explains what happened, what to do, and takes you with a button to the page where it is done — the Cash book already filtered on that account, Transfers, Accounts, the General Ledger. The bridge is line by line with the name of each item: unpaid invoices, withholdings not yet paid, instalments not yet collected.

FREE AND RESERVED CASH — Bank and petty cash on one side, funds on the other, fund by fund with its restriction. The check «declared restrictions ≤ cash held in funds» has its outcome per fund: a fund holding less than what is assigned to it is red and says how much is missing; a restriction with no fund account is a warning; a full general fund with no restrictions is not an anomaly. A fund with no declared subtype is restricted, not free. Funds remain partitions of the current account: the total counts them once.

THE YEAR'S CASH SUMMARY — For each account: opening balance, receipts, payments, closing balance — as art. 1130-bis requires. Each row balances on its own; transfers between accounts count in the rows but not in the total, which shows only flows with the outside. A receipt split across two accounts no longer breaks the page. A reversed entry does not count: original and reversal cancel out and sit neither among receipts nor among payments, which are the real flows; both remain readable in the Cash book. A bank or petty cash account that went below zero even for a single day is flagged, with amount and date — at end of day, because an entry's date has no time.

WHO I OWE, RIGHT AWAY — The «Payables» card opens the list of invoices still to be paid, with supplier, document, due date and outstanding amount, and each row has a «Pay» button that opens the payment with that invoice already selected. At the bottom, the sum of the outstanding amounts is compared with the suppliers account balance, and withholdings to be paid link to the F24s.

TESTED ON A NEW BUILDING, ACTION BY ACTION — Before closing the beta the page was followed step by step on a building created from scratch: opening the bank account, a fund with a transfer, issuing instalments, a receipt, an invoice with withholding, payment from the modal, an expense larger than the balance, its reversal, the reversal of the receipt, the F24 payment, the print, a future financial year. The expected figures were worked out by hand before opening the page, and they all matched. The test found and fixed one thing: after reversing an expense the «below zero» check stayed red for an instant that does not exist.

FOLLOWING THE BUTTONS GETS YOU THERE — Tried on a building with the financial year on the wrong dates and a bank account with no opening balance: both red checks clear by following only the suggested fixes. «Cash and summary» recognises when it is the year's dates that are wrong and takes you to edit them; «Real accounts below zero» tells a bank with no opening balance and no receipts apart from an entry on the wrong account, and takes you to register the opening balance — which can now be registered on an account with entries too, if no opening was ever recorded (the form used to refuse, silently).

A RECEIPT WITH AN INSTALMENT PAID BY CREDIT CAME OUT «REVERSED» — Found while closing the beta on a building with two funds and four reversals: the «instalment paid with credit» entry, child of a valid receipt, starts like a reversal and the Cash book criterion (beta.24) took it for one. That receipt was marked «reversed» in print, and the cash summary was missing 24.57 from the bank's receipts, with the «Cash and summary» check red. Real reversals are now an explicit list, with two tests.

PRINTS WITH THEIR OWN NAME, AND THREE TOUCH-UPS — The three books download as «stato-patrimoniale-<building>-2026-al-<date>.pdf», «prima-nota-…», «libro-giornale-…» instead of «print.pdf». In the supplier payment a long company name no longer pushes the × and the arrow onto a second line (applies to every single-choice menu); the entry preview in immediate settlement and transfers no longer uses a monospace font; in the financial position the code column is as wide as needed.

FINANCIAL YEAR NOT YET STARTED — If the start date is in the future the page says so, instead of showing a snapshot as of today that contains the previous year. «Today» is the user's date in Italy, not the server's in UTC.

WHAT THE OTHER MODULES WILL COMPLETE, AND IS NOT AN OVERSIGHT — At the bottom of the page and of the print: it does not list the unit owners who owe money, only the total — the per-unit list comes with the arrears and reminders module, and will open from here. It does not compare with the bank statement — it remains the administrator's check until bank reconciliation exists, which will become a check on this page. It does not close the year — the snapshot at 31/12 will become final with the guided closing. Three planned hooks, not three holes.
